question: Spaced repetition for deferred board items, re-weighed in new context
wendell: We want to use spaced repetition so that tasks that are deferred come back and the council can weigh in on them in new context.
dissent_note: The Challenger would cap the schedule and ask him to retire or take up an item after repeated deferrals; set down because a cap is a number inferred on his behalf.
cast_grade: Two casts changed a face's output (Bearing put the numbers on the board; Depths sent a second look that found an overclaim). Neither is shown to depend on the cast rather than the rules in force. Weak evidence; second of three.
